ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of light-gray (high-intensity) to dark-gray/black (low-intensity) pixels; high local contrast at the trailing edge margin and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary light-gray field across center lobes; low-intensity pigmentation concentrated in a continuous band along the trailing edge; a prominent vertical dark linear feature at approximately x=700 on the right lobe; diffused gray mottling on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal pixel-angle of 40 degrees; depth occupies roughly 30% of the visible vertical lobe extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; primary peaks exhibit 10-15 pixel amplitudes; distinct jagged notches visible at x=310 on the left lobe and x=650 on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory from notch to tips; both lobes exhibit a sharp upward vertical sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-relief circular nodules (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer margins and tips of both lobes; high-contrast white-on-gray clusters at the extreme left margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct parallel vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-right lobe surface; multiple finer horizontal scratches on the left lobe center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe; extensive barnacle encrustation on distal edges providing a jagged perimeter texture.
other_distinctive_markers: Deep irregular excision on the trailing edge of the left lobe located approximately midway between the notch and tip.
